data.review_body:
I received a present from my dad that was explicitly advertised and pictured as a ceramic egg-style Kamado grill, complete with the signature dimpled finish and described as being made from ceramic for excellent heat retention. With the recent nice weather, I was really looking forward to enjoying it in the garden with friends.
Instead, I received a completely different item – a cheap, standard sheet-metal barbecue grill.
As soon as the parcel arrived, we opened the box, immediately saw it was not the item that had been advertised, and closed it again to request a return and full refund. It has now been three weeks of writing to both Temu Support and the seller, Home Interiors Hinckley, almost every day, yet they have still failed to provide the return documents or resolve the issue.

Temu's customer support has been completely ineffective. We have chatted with 26 different support agents, but none has been able to resolve what should have been a straightforward case of receiving the wrong item.

I am extremely disappointed with both the seller for false advertising and Temu for its appalling lack of customer service. Save your money and shop elsewhere. In my experience, Temu is only worth considering for items under £3
data.review_headline: don't waste your time trying to contact them will not help
